v4.6.74 — Bot-creation instructions + many more universes

✨ NEW
• The Make Bot tab’s instructions now match the new flow: pick the AI, the brokers, and the ticker universe — the AI writes the bot’s name, description and method (the card info) for you.
• The AI is now told to trade EXACTLY the tickers of the public universe you pick (or pick sensible ones itself if you choose “Let the AI choose”).

🌐 UNIVERSES (server-side)
• Greatly expanded the curated public universes from 6 to 34: sector packs (semiconductors, AI infrastructure, software/cloud, cybersecurity, fintech, banks, EV/clean-energy, energy, healthcare, biotech, consumer, industrials, communication, retail, REITs, defense, travel, China ADRs, index & sector ETFs) plus factor packs (mega-cap, high-growth, low-volatility, dividend income, momentum leaders, meme) and crypto majors. They show up automatically in the Make Bot universe dropdown.

Update via the in-app banner.
